en: Protecting and defending freedoms like healthcare, education, and the right to vote.
Will respect the NC Constitution and apply the principles of conserving liberty to every case.
Stands with experience, integrity, and courage for equal justice under the law.
Believes passionately in due process, fairness, and giving all sides a chance to be heard.
A Cornell-educated leader bringing discipline, integrity, and legal excellence to the bench.
Defending the rule of law, protecting your rights, and looking out for your family.
Conservative judge who will uphold the Constitution and the rule of law.
Safeguarding the fundamental rights and liberties of all with swift and nonpartisan decisions.
Supporting victims, obtaining justice, and creating safer streets and communities.
Will protect individuals' rights, respect all parties, and work to ensure justice is served.
Has experience as both a Superior Court Judge and District Court judge in NC.
A champion for justice who leads with commitment, conviction and collaboration.
I understand the need to make fair and impartial decisions that comply with the law.
Approaching decisions diligently, thoughtfully and fairly.
Gives parties an opportunity to be heard, listens respectfully, treats people with dignity.
Showing commitment to the job, knowledge of the law, and an open minded approach.
Ensuring that the courthouse is a place where equality and justice prevails for all.
Washington & Lee University Law graduate and incumbent for the district.
Guided by fairness, integrity, and respect for every person who enters the courtroom.
Recognizes the importance of fairness, consistency and the safety of the community.
Efficient, effective and experienced service on the bench.
